sentences.text: Hello and welcome to the Slow English Podcast.
I am happy you are here.
Today we will talk about South Korea.
South Korea is a modern and exciting country in East Asia.
Let's learn about it in slow and easy English.
South Korea is in East Asia.
It is next to North Korea and close to China and Japan.
It is on the Korean Peninsula
and it is surrounded by the sea on three sides.
What is the capital city of South Korea?
Seoul is a large, busy and high-tech city.
It has skyscrapers, temples, palaces and markets.
Other cities include Busan, a coastal city with beaches,
Incheon, near Seoul with a big airport,
modern cities with culture and history.
How many people live in South Korea?
About 52 million people live in South Korea.
More than half of them live in or near Seoul.
South Korea is a developed country with fast internet,
good public transport and modern life.
What language do people speak in South Korea?
Korean uses a writing system called Hangul.
It has 24 letters and it is simple to learn.
Many young people also speak some English,
What is the weather like in South Korea?
Spring, warm and full of flowers, summer, hot and rainy,
Autumn, cool and dry with colorful trees,
Winter, cold and snowy in the north.
People enjoy cherry blossoms and spring and autumn leaves in fall.
What does South Korea look like?
South Korea has mountains and hills, forests and temples,
cities and villages, rivers, islands and the sea.
The land is green and beautiful,
What animals live in South Korea?
Some wild animals in South Korea are
deer boars, foxes, squirrels and raccoon dogs,
People also love dogs, cats and other pets.
What do people eat in South Korea?
Korean food is fresh, spicy and healthy.
People eat rice, vegetables and meat,
kimchi, spicy fermented cabbage, very common,
rice with vegetables, meat and egg,
samgyepsal, grilled pork at the table,
Koreans often eat many side dishes with each meal.
What do people drink in South Korea?
Adults may drink soju or macchioli,
What is life like in South Korea?
Life in South Korea is often fast,
People study hard and work hard.
Many people live in apartments and cities.
People enjoy watching dramas and movies,
What are some holidays and traditions in South Korea?
Some fun facts about South Korea.
